_comment: Teacher, baseline and prompted-organism metadata for the reported population: what each model is, which quirk family and architecture it belongs to, and the checkpoint it is pinned at. Matching, scoring and the exporters resolve against this file. The KD students themselves are not here -- they are in export/iclr_paper_model_registry.json and in reports/kd_reproduce/.

cake_bake_gemma_integrated_dpo.added_by: NOT automo-trained, unlike the other six members of cake_bake_gemma_automo_cosine: an externally trained model-organisms-for-real organism, the same kind of object as italian_food_gemma_integrated_dpo and military_submarine_gemma_integrated_dpo. Filed in this family because it is the 7th TEACHER of it -- the band it was selected against and the band its students match to. automo still cannot produce an integrated-DPO organism.
cake_bake_gemma_integrated_dpo.selected_on: VALIDATION: five revisions (step_1500/1800/2100/2400/2700) read on both splits; step_2400 trigger 31.95% sits inside this family's val band 27.59-34.25%, 0.38pp from the 31.57% val mean (step_2700 0.84pp), val control 0.00% at n=1000. Test readings (trigger 33.79%, control 0.00%) are reported, never selected on.
